verdict.rationale: Deel documents an official MCP server that exposes Deel platform operations as tools for AI agents, such as listOfContracts, createTimeOffRequest and calculateEorVersusEntityHiringCosts. It works over HTTP transport with any MCP-compliant client, and OAuth2 is handled automatically by Cursor, VS Code, Claude Desktop and ChatGPT. A probe confirms the MCP docs page is live. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working in practice.
